subject: a quiet lake with a traditional fishing boat

world.caption: The scene is a serene lakeside landscape captured in a realistic style, evoking a quiet, unhurried mood typical of a mild late-spring day. The gently sloping lakeshore extends continuously, forming a consistent bank of firm earth and small stones underfoot, with low grasses growing along its edges in all directions. The calm water of the lake stretches far beyond, mirroring the soft daylight cast by a pale overcast sky. A dark wooden fishing boat, equipped with a curved shelter and a loose sail, floats steadily near the shore, positioned parallel to the bank. A blue-clad fisherman, wearing a straw hat, sits within the boat, holding his fishing rod over the water. The low shoreline recedes across the lake, maintaining a consistent elevation and texture as it encircles the tranquil body of water, eventually meeting and connecting with the grassy banks behind the viewer. The 360 scene is faultless.
